properties.eventTitle: High network latency and VM connectivity degradation — Availability Zone 2 (West Europe)
properties.summary: Starting at 04:08 UTC on 30 October 2026, Azure identified degraded network performance affecting virtual machines and managed disks in Availability Zone 2 of the West Europe region. Workloads in Zone 2 may experience intermittent packet loss, elevated VM connectivity latency, and managed-disk attach and detach timeouts. Engineering is engaged; no customer action is required at this time.
